lines.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
You have rejected us, O God;
You have shown Your people hardship;
we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
You have raised a banner for those who fear You,
that they may flee the bow.
Respond and save us with Your right hand,
that Your beloved may be delivered.

pictures.scene: Albrecht Altdorfer, The Battle of Alexander at Issus — the two armies locked together under a sky torn open from end to end, a Miktam of David for instruction when he fought Aram and Joab struck down the Edomites in the Valley of Salt, You have rejected us O God
pictures.name: pd_altdorfer_the_battle_of_alexander_at_issus

pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Siege and Destruction of Jerusalem by the Romans — the city burning and its walls coming down in smoke, You have broken us, You have been angry
pictures.name: pd_roberts_the_siege_and_destruction_of_jerusalem

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — the survivors clinging to the broken mast as the sun comes up through the sea, restore us, You have shaken the land
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_the_ninth_wave

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Cotopaxi — the mountain split open and pouring ash across a blood-red sun, and torn it open, heal its fractures
pictures.name: pd_church_cotopaxi

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, Man with a Hoe — the laborer stopped over his hoe in the broken ground, worn right through, for it is quaking, You have shown Your people hardship
pictures.name: pd_millet_man_with_a_hoe

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Province — the crowd pressing along the road behind the banners, one man reeling in the dust, we are staggered from the wine You made us drink, You have raised a banner for those who fear You
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Chasseur in the Forest — the lone soldier standing small at the edge of the great dark wood, that they may flee the bow, Selah
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_chasseur_in_the_forest

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father's hands laid on the back of the son knelt against him, respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_return_of_the_prodigal_son
